containers.layout_description: Structured containers derive focus relationships from their layout model.
containers.scroll_description: Auto, always-visible and hidden scrollbars retain the same clipped content behavior.

overlays.tooltip_text: Tooltip content follows focus and pointer state.
overlays.placement_description: One owned panel is reopened with every placement, transition and modality policy.
overlays.dialog_description: Dialogs capture focus and restore the previous scope when they close.
overlays.popup_description: Transient popups take priority while tooltips remain passive.

confirm.title: Confirm workbench action
confirm.message: This confirmation dialog is part of the overlay coverage.

appearance.note: Theme names are stable engine identifiers.

motion.title: Bodies, forces and mass
motion.purpose: Compare static, kinematic and dynamic bodies; gravity, damping and rotation.
motion.expected: Static bodies stay put; forces and impulses respond to mass; damping slows movement.

materials.title: Contacts, materials and sleep
materials.purpose: Observe floor/wall/ceiling contacts, friction, bounce and stack wake-up.
materials.expected: Contacts identify each surface; friction changes sliding; a sleeping stack wakes after an impulse.

ccd.title: Continuous collision regression
ccd.purpose: Eight lanes compare discrete controls, runtime CCD, multiple colliders and bullet flags.
ccd.expected: Continuous lanes stop at targets; discrete control lanes may tunnel.

filters.title: Filters and sensor events
filters.purpose: Block / Overlap / Ignore, masks, groups and exactly one End after removal.
filters.expected: Masks and groups select pairs; sensors report Begin/Stay and one End on disable or removal.

queries.title: Shape queries and casts
queries.purpose: Rays, segments, overlaps, sweeps, rotation, filtering and immediate teleport queries.
queries.expected: Queries return sorted, filtered hits and immediately observe teleports.

one_way.title: Directional platforms
one_way.purpose: Test allowed and blocked approaches for all four directions and combined rules.
one_way.expected: Each direction blocks its solid side and permits passage from the opposite side.

tiles.title: Tile seams and moving supports
tiles.purpose: Stand across a seam, drop through both supports, reland, remove tiles and ride a platform.
tiles.expected: Seam supports allow stable standing and drop-through; moving platforms carry riders.

joints.title: Constraints, springs and motors
joints.purpose: Distance, spring settling, motor limits and invalidation after joint/body destruction.
joints.expected: Constraints remain bounded, springs settle, and destroyed joints become invalid.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle and ordered commands
lifecycle.purpose: Callback registration/removal, XY writes, rotation + teleport, reset and angle stability.
lifecycle.expected: Queued writes preserve order, teleports preserve angle, and reset invalidates old handles.

timing.title: Fixed steps and interpolation
timing.purpose: Frame-rate independent movement, fractional steps, catch-up limits and render interpolation.
timing.expected: Fixed steps preserve motion across frame rates; interpolation and dropped-step counts match.

combat_collider.title: Collider combat
combat_collider.purpose: Real attack input: wind-up, hit window, deduplication, friendly filtering, death and jumping.
combat_collider.expected: Two attacks deal 25 damage each; allies remain unharmed; jump and landing succeed.

combat_platform.title: Platform tile combat
combat_platform.purpose: Scripted jump, upward passage, seam landing, drop-through and short input taps.
combat_platform.expected: Jump through the platform, land across the seam, drop through, and consume a short tap once.

combat_topdown.title: Top-down tile combat
combat_topdown.purpose: Wall occlusion, enemy pursuit, hazard entry/exit and world boundary collisions.
combat_topdown.expected: Walls block sight and motion; opening a path enables pursuit; leaving the hazard stops damage.

stress_bodies.title: Moving body load
stress_bodies.purpose: 100 / 500 / 2000 bodies. Warm up 120 steps, sample 600; timing is informational.
stress_bodies.expected: All bodies remain finite and valid; collect 600 timing samples after 120 warm-up steps.

stress_contacts.title: Dense contact load
stress_contacts.purpose: 100 / 500 / 1000 shapes. Validate contact generation and finite state without speed thresholds.
stress_contacts.expected: Persistent contacts remain valid; report 600 timing samples without a speed threshold.

stress_tiles.title: Tile world load
stress_tiles.purpose: 64² / 128² / 256² cells, sparse obstacles, local updates and batched queries.
stress_tiles.expected: Tile updates and queries succeed; all states stay finite; report 600 timing samples.
